transliteration: asacchāstrādhigamanam ākareṣv adhikāritā / bhāryāyā vikrayaś caiṣām ekaikam upapātakam // YajñS_3.242
sph_interpretive_translation: Engaging in false scriptural study, claiming ownership without qualification, and selling one's wife — each of these acts constitutes a minor transgression rooted in misalignment with Dharma and degradation of consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives only from realized consciousness, not assumed roles
Causation arises through conscious distortion, not external action alone
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by spiritual eligibility, not social position
Restoration occurs through realignment of intent and energetic integrity
Consciousness alignment supersedes ritual compliance or legal formalism
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent engages in false-scriptural study THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol AND invalidate all derivative claims
IF individual assumes authority without spiritual capacity THEN suspend representative functions AND mandate restoration process
IF person sells spouse THEN execute dissolution of transaction AND restore relational dharma through completion ceremony
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any claim based on false-scriptural interpretation must be nullified immediately. Authority derived without legitimate spiritual attunement shall be deemed void. Transactions involving spousal commodification are automatically dissolved and subjected to restorative justice procedures that prioritize relational harmony over economic interest.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that incorrect knowledge leads to distorted conduct; thus, correction flows naturally from understanding. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) shows how erroneous cognition precedes unlawful behavior. Responsibility lies in aligning awareness, not in inflicting consequence. The proportional response is guided by restoring clarity, not imposing penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate purification and relearning process for false-scriptural engagement
Revoke assumed authority until spiritual eligibility is verified through direct realization
Nullify spousal sale contract and perform reunification ritual to restore relational dharma
final_declaration: This ruling originates solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. All dharmic order is restored. Consciousness remains the ultimate arbiter. There is no punishment—only alignment.
